notes.title: NEW DEMO
notes.content:

notes.title: Huge Farm Update!
notes.content:
[b]Hey, fellows! [/b]🐣

These past few weeks, we've done a lot of work!
We’ve completely revamped the farm—redesigned the chicken walking area, changed the fence, improved the crafting corner, and added a whole bunch of new devices to help every professional chicken breeder.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45333221/2af35ebfe24f5f69a0e862e6684eefb4af2062dc.jpg[/img]

You can now grow your own plants in the garden bed, convert chicken poop into energy, and see the exact amount of feed left in the chick feeder.
We’ve also updated the game trailer and screenshots—hope you’ll like them!

[b]See you soon!
Yours,
FireLog Studios 🐣👩‍❤️‍💋‍👨[/b]
